pages.text: Rift Shards are the endgame currency. The Ender Dragon, the Wither, the Warden and other late bosses drop them. Farm them to fund the $(bold)Mythic Gear Chase$(), the character improvement loop that comes after Tier 4.$(br2)$(bold)Rift Keystone$(): 5 Rift Shards plus a boss material. It is meant to open Oblivion's Rift, a dungeon that is designed but not in the game yet.

$(bold)Mythic Infusion$()$(br2)Mythic infusion raises a Legendary item to Mythic tier (Mythic I to V). Each Mythic level:$(br)$(li)raises every existing affix value by ~15%$(li)adds one more socket$(li)unlocks a visual effect on the item
Mythic V is the ceiling. Reaching it takes long boss farming: it is the long-term endgame loop, by design.$(br2)$(bold)Next: farm Rift Shards from late bosses.$()
